# Scripts

Utility scripts for agents and developers. Run them from the repository root.

| Pack | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `agent-env-tools/` | PowerShell diagnostics that report which CLI tools are available (required and optional). See its `README.md`. |
| `docs-check/` | Validates ADR front matter, the generated ADR index, relative links and instruction-file citations, and rejects document IDs in code. Pester tests included. See its `README.md`. |
